acceptance: The repair PR is merged by the owner under docs/agent/emergency-merge.md, and the ruleset is restored to match /tmp/ruleset-15611785-before.json.
The next PR review posts an oracle-verdict status and review from benchbox-oracle[bot], and oracle-gate posts its status.
Theseus docs and example callers state that callers pass secrets: inherit for environment secrets.
description: Base-pinned gate breakage on develop dff1efde16 (PR #3942). oracle-verdict.yml and oracle-gate.yml call the Theseus reusable workflows with environment: oracle. GitHub only exposes environment-scoped secrets to a called workflow when the caller passes secrets: inherit (https://github.com/actions/runner/issues/4453), so every secrets.* is empty. Reproduced on the first ordinary PR after the merge: run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/actions/runs/41887238141 on PR #3925, head 65b7e90ff9cf5812520e65180c3f41a86727c46e. The run logged "oracle-verdict is not posted because the App secrets are not set" and "pending: no reviewer available"; no oracle-verdict or oracle-gate status was posted, and gate / gate fails. The breakage came in with commit dff1efde16 (.github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml, .github/workflows/oracle-gate.yml). No open or recently merged PR clears it. Repair: add secrets: inherit to every job calling a Theseus workflow. The repair cannot pass the base-pinned gate; under docs/agent/emergency-merge.md the owner merges it. Ruleset capture: /tmp/ruleset-15611785-before.json (develop-squash-only, active).
